$comment: Per-city fixes for the 10 location documents, keyed by slug, applied by scripts/migrate/content/fixes.mjs: the bare city `name`, the homepage tile `cardBlurb` (only the 5 cities that have a tile), `featuredServices` (6-8, ordered by Search Console demand) and `nearbyLocations`. Mesa is the homepage, so it only appears as `homeCity`. Evidence figures are Search Console impressions '3-month / 16-month' from the redesign gsc-queries.md §4.2 and §5 (and gsc-data/service-city-pairs.json). See README.md.

homeCity.name: Mesa
homeCity.cardBlurb: Eastmark, Las Sendas, Red Mountain Ranch, and Dobson Ranch.
homeCity.cardBlurbSource: Live homepage (and /commercial-electrician) 'We proudly serve the entire valley!' Mesa tile: "Eastmark, Las Sendas, Red Mountain Ranch, and Dobson Ranch" (closing period added for consistency with the other tiles).

gilbert.name: Gilbert
gilbert.cardBlurb: Power Ranch, Val Vista Lakes, Seville, Morrison Ranch, and Agritopia.
gilbert.featuredEvidence: §5 order 'repair · EV · commercial · residential · panels · lighting · low voltage'. Repair 200/9; EV 288/542 ('electric car charger installation gilbert' 227 @15.9); commercial 113/421 ('commercial electrician gilbert' 412 @8.0); panels 73/7; lighting 69 ('lighting electrician gilbert' 38 @5.3); new construction 52 ('gilbert new construction electrical' 32 @21.1); rewire 82 ('gilbert whole home wiring' 19 @14.7). Residential and low voltage have no single service page.
gilbert.nearbyEvidence: Borders Chandler and Queen Creek (and Mesa); Tempe is the next closest city centre (10.1 mi).
